# mcp2cli skill text (vendored)

`SKILL.md` is the agent skill that [mcp2cli](https://github.com/knowsuchagency/mcp2cli) ships (`skills/mcp2cli/SKILL.md` on `main`, fetched for mcp2cli 3.8.0), copied unchanged. The token benchmark counts it as mcp2cli's instruction text, the counterpart of `via prompt`. It is vendored so that the benchmark stays offline and reproducible.
